def deduplicate(items, keys):
    """Deduplicate a list of dicts by specified keys, keeping the first occurrence."""
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        key = tuple(item.get(k) for k in keys)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(item)
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import unittest

    class TestDeduplicate(unittest.TestCase):
        def test_basic(self):
            data = [
                {"id": 1, "name": "a"},
                {"id": 2, "name": "b"},
                {"id": 1, "name": "c"},
            ]
            result = deduplicate(data, ["id"])
            self.assertEqual(result, [{"id": 1, "name": "a"}, {"id": 2, "name": "b"}])

        def test_composite_key(self):
            data = [
                {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3},
                {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 9},
                {"a": 1, "b": 3, "c": 3},
            ]
            result = deduplicate(data, ["a", "b"])
            self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
            self.assertEqual(result[0]["c"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(result[1]["c"], 3)

        def test_empty(self):
            self.assertEqual(deduplicate([], ["id"]), [])

        def test_no_duplicates(self):
            data = [{"x": 1}, {"x": 2}]
            self.assertEqual(deduplicate(data, ["x"]), data)

        def test_missing_key(self):
            data = [{"a": 1}, {"b": 2}, {"a": 1}]
            result = deduplicate(data, ["a"])
            self.assertEqual(result, [{"a": 1}, {"b": 2}])

        def test_keeps_first_occurrence(self):
            data = [
                {"id": 1, "val": "first"},
                {"id": 1, "val": "second"},
            ]
            result = deduplicate(data, ["id"])
            self.assertEqual(result[0]["val"], "first")

    unittest.main()
